T: I hate the way you skip dessert.
D: A new kid pays the school bad boy to date the sharp-tongued older sister so he can take out the younger one.
P: Serve the snacks when Patrick starts singing to Kat across the football bleachers.
S: Hot baked spinach and artichoke dip with cream cheese and mozzarella
Hot baked dip of cream cheese, spinach, artichoke and mozzarella with toasted baguette for scooping.

Little beef and pork meatballs baked crisp, served on a white platter splattered with a sticky tomato glaze, mango chutney and basil oil like paint. Mix 500g beef and pork mince with 40g breadcrumbs, an egg, a grated garlic clove and salt, roll into 30 small balls and bake at 200C for 15 minutes. Simmer 150ml tomato sauce with 2 tbsp brown sugar and 1 tbsp vinegar until sticky. Blitz a bunch of basil with 80ml olive oil and salt. Toss the meatballs in some of the glaze, then splatter the platter with glaze, mango chutney and basil oil.
Ham and gruyere sandwiches under creamy béchamel, grilled and cut small
Ham and gruyère toasties brushed with Dijon and béchamel, grilled until bubbling, cut into small squares.
M: Seattle salmon burgers with dill mayo
Padua High in the rainy Pacific Northwest

Salmon chopped with spring onion, lemon zest and panko, seared into patties and served in toasted brioche buns with dill mayo, rocket and pickled cucumber. Slice a Lebanese cucumber thinly and soak in 3 tbsp rice vinegar with a pinch of sugar and salt. Chop 600g skinless salmon finely and mix with 2 sliced spring onions, lemon zest, 50g panko, an egg and salt. Shape into 4 patties and chill 20 minutes. Sear in oil for 3 minutes a side. Mix 4 tbsp mayonnaise with chopped dill and lemon juice. Build in toasted brioche buns with rocket and pickles.
Penne in a creamy vodka tomato sauce with parmesan and basil
Penne with a vodka sauce of tomato, cream, garlic and chilli simmered until rosy, finished with parmesan and basil.
W: Fudgy dark chocolate brownies cut in ten squares, each topped differently
Fudgy dark chocolate brownies baked at 170C for 25 minutes, cut into ten squares, each topped with something different: raspberries, nuts, salt flakes, cherries.
K: Espresso shaken with vanilla syrup, poured over ice and cold milk

Cold espresso shaken with homemade vanilla syrup and ice until frothy, poured over cold milk in tall glasses so it settles in layers. Simmer 80g sugar with 80ml water and a split vanilla bean for 3 minutes and cool. Brew 4 strong espresso shots, or 250ml very strong coffee, and cool. Shake the coffee with 2 tbsp vanilla syrup and a handful of ice until frothy. Fill four tall glasses with ice and 150ml cold milk each, then pour the frothy coffee slowly over the top so it sits in layers.

dishes.make_ahead: Up to 1 day, assemble and bake fresh

ingredients.item: frozen spinach, thawed and squeezed dry
jar artichoke hearts, drained and chopped

steps.text: Mix the cream cheese, sour cream, spinach, artichokes, garlic and mozzarella and spoon into a baking dish.
Bake at 190C until bubbling. Meanwhile slice and toast the baguette.
Serve the dip hot with the toasted baguette.

Spread the bread with Dijon and fill with ham and some of the gruyere.
Top with bechamel and the rest of the cheese. Grill until bubbling and golden, then cut into small squares.

s.note: Hot baked spinach and artichoke dip with cream cheese and mozzarella
s.how: Mix 250g softened cream cheese with 100g sour cream, 250g thawed spinach squeezed dry, 1 jar drained chopped artichoke hearts, 1 crushed garlic clove and 100g grated mozzarella. Bake at 190C for 20 minutes until bubbling and serve with toasted baguette slices.

s.note: Ham and gruyere sandwiches under creamy béchamel, grilled and cut small
s.how: Make a quick bechamel with 30g butter, a spoon of flour and 250ml milk. Spread bread with Dijon, fill with ham and grated gruyere, and top with bechamel and more cheese. Grill until bubbling and golden, then cut into small squares to share.

m.note: Penne in a creamy vodka tomato sauce with parmesan and basil
m.how: Soften crushed garlic and a pinch of chilli in olive oil. Add a can of crushed tomatoes and 60ml vodka and simmer 10 minutes. Stir in 200ml cream until rosy. Toss with 500g cooked penne, then finish with grated parmesan and torn basil.

w.note: Fudgy dark chocolate brownies cut in ten squares, each topped differently
w.how: Melt 200g dark chocolate with 150g butter. Whisk in 250g sugar and 3 eggs, then fold in 100g flour. Bake in a lined tin at 170C for 25 minutes and cool. Cut into ten squares and top each differently with raspberries, nuts, salt flakes or anything you like.

d.note: Espresso shaken with vanilla syrup, poured over ice and cold milk

Shake the coffee with 2 tbsp vanilla syrup and a handful of ice until frothy. Fill four tall glasses with ice and 150ml cold milk each, then pour the frothy coffee slowly over the top so it sits in layers.
